name: Retribution (4 Winds Fantasy Gaming)
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 2, paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration until activated; see text
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

If the target fails their Will save, the next time they deal damage – via physical or magical attack – of any type to any creature, they suffer an equal number of points of damage of the same type. If the target is aware that they are under the affects of retribution before they make an attack, the spell can be removed by dispel magic, limited wish, wish or miracle. Retribution is often cast as a punishment or to teach a lesson.

Retribution, Greater

School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 4, paladin 4

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as retribution, except that the target will suffer double the damage they dealt on their next attack (or, in the case of a spell, the maximum damage possible, whichever is lower).
